archetypes.name: dyn-hook-state
archetypes.rationale: Hook temp-state hardening depends on fail-open symlink and non-regular path behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the read-poll hook state-dir and leaf-state handling for unsafe filesystem operations. Focus on whether symlinked or non-regular state paths can still redirect reads, temp creation, promotion, or truncation. Also check that the regression harness proves both the blocked parent-dir path and the replacement leaf-state path without depending on platform-specific behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
